notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-sV against a single specific port performs targeted service version detection. More efficient than scanning all ports when the interesting port is already known. Nmap sends service-appropriate probes to fingerprint the application.

=== -sV LOGIC ===
1. Banner read attempt. 2. If insufficient: send protocol probe strings. 3. Match against nmap-service-probes database. Banner = fast. Signature matching = slow but comprehensive.

=== OUTPUT ===
SERVICE VERSION EXTRA-INFO: 'OpenSSH 7.6p1 Ubuntu 4ubuntu0.3 (Ubuntu Linux; protocol 2.0)'. Contains: service, version, OS distribution, protocol version. All directly usable for CVE lookup.
